ops.text: (j) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where Garman processes, stores or has access to Sparkling's data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Garman shall provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a short insurance covenant as new General Matters (j), since Garman installs on our AS400s at the Authorized Locations and converts Sparkling's data but the Agreement carries no insurance at all. We have dropped the one-year post-term tail so the covenant runs for the term only; if the limits are an issue we can discuss E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new General Matters subsection (j)

mappings.element: Commercial general liability of USD 1M per occurrence.
Commercial general liability of USD 2M aggregate.

Workers' compensation as required by law.
